title: Adventure
intro: Scenic and nature-focused adventure calibrated to relaxed-cultural profile. Both travelers in excellent physical condition. Great Wall (Day 3) is the China anchor. September Vietnam: warm water (~28°C), calm inshore at Mỹ Khê; typhoon watch on open-ocean activities. No extreme sports.

bullets.heading: Great Wall Gear & Tips
items: Comfortable walking shoes (NOT sandals); sunscreen; water
Wall vendors charge ¥25 for water at top
Toboggan: 580 m descent from Tower 6, ~3 min — exhilarating but not extreme
Day 3 is not a border day — CLEAR

bullets.heading: Cham Islands Snorkeling
items: 18 km offshore; speedboat ~45 min; Cham Island Diving Center (PADI certified)
Book 1 day ahead, not in advance; full-day trip with lunch
Plan Day 11 afternoon after fitting; treat as weather-dependent bonus
Operators cancel if sea conditions deteriorate

bullets.heading: Operator Vetting
items: Snorkeling: ask PADI certification, boat capacity, life jackets
Water activities: daily equipment inspection; cancellation/refund policy
Son Trà: vehicle insurance; private guide preferred
Book through resort concierge or TripAdvisor-rated operators — avoid street touts

callouts.text: Cham Islands snorkeling: September end of good season — check weather 48 hrs before; visibility varies
All outdoor adventure before 11 AM or in protected cave/water environments (heat deal-breaker)
Border crossing days (6, 8) have NO adventure activities
Recovery built in: Days 1, 6, 8, 13 are soft/rest days — no adventure fatigue risk
